findings.text: the wait-met action tells the reader the recovery sweep lifts the run only once its process is observed to have ended, but the sweep's sole process guard refuses only a proven-live process (reckon/crew/resumption.py:596, with reckon/crew/runs.py:3466-3478 answering None for a record that names no process), so a run reading "liveness unknown" is lifted once its condition reports terminal with no observation of the end — the row overstates its hold in exactly the reading that cannot rule out a live worker.
